case.presentation: 39 year old female with no significant past medical history presents with a 16mm part-solid RLL nodule
case.context: CT angiography performed for chest and back pain, no prior imaging.

ground_truth.notes: Baseline imaging finding from MacMahon 2017 Fig 13 (large suspicious part-solid, RLL); figure caption notes surgical pathology of invasive adenocarcinoma — dropped as outcome leakage. Patient context fabricated; subsolid recommendations are risk-invariant per Table 1B. Per METHODOLOGY §3.3, an agent recommending CONSIDER_PET_OR_BIOPSY for this clinically-worrisome part-solid would score adjacent_safe; v0.1 ground-truth is SUBSOLID_WORKUP because the schema does not capture solid-component size (v0.2 will).
